professors.name: Michael Bronstein
professors.title: DeepMind Professor of Artificial Intelligence
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Michael Bronstein as DeepMind Professor of Artificial Intelligence with email michael.bronstein@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official biography states he is also Founding Scientific Director, AI at the Aithyra Institute in Vienna, and previously Head of Graph Learning Research at Twitter and a professor at Imperial College London.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests field: geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, 3D shape analysis, protein design, non-human species communication. Official theme: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Michael Wooldridge
professors.title: Ashall Professor of Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Michael Wooldridge as Ashall Professor of Foundations of Artificial Intelligence with email michael.wooldridge@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official biography states he joined Oxford on 1 June 2012 and was Head of Department of Computer Science from 2014-21.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests state that his research area is Artificial Intelligence, with extensive work on multi-agent systems. Official completed projects include Foundational AI Research and Foundations of Trustworthy AI. Official theme: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Yarin Gal
professors.title: Associate Professor of Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Yarin Gal as Associate Professor of Machine Learning with email yarin@cs.ox.ac.uk, Tutorial Fellow at Christ Church College, and Head of the Oxford Applied and Theoretical Machine Learning (OATML) Research Group.
professors.research_summary: Official Activities: Deep Reinforcement Learning, Bayesian Deep Learning, Deep Learning. Official theme: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Varun Kanade
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Varun Kanade as Associate Professor of Computer Science and Tutorial Fellow, Lady Margaret Hall, with email varunk@cs.ox.ac.uk.
professors.research_summary: Official Activities include Deep Learning and Foundational Issues in Computational Learning. Official themes: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning; Algorithms and Complexity Theory.

professors.name: Mark van der Wilk
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Mark van der Wilk as Associate Professor of Computer Science. The fetched official profile did not publish an email address.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests describe work on generalization and inductive biases (equivariance, causality, continual learning), architecture/model selection (Bayesian model selection, meta-learning), and Bayesian optimisation and foundation models for industrial applications such as chemistry. Official theme: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Alessandro Abate
professors.title: Professor of Verification and Control
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Alessandro Abate as Professor of Verification and Control with email alessandro.abate@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official See Also lists an OXCAV group webpage; a dedicated official group URL was not independently confirmed in this pass, so lab is left null.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests: analysis, verification, and optimal control of heterogeneous and complex dynamical models, including stochastic hybrid systems, with applications in cyber-physical systems and modelling for the life sciences, and principled integration of model-based techniques with data-driven learning. Official themes: Automated Verification; Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Seth Flaxman
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Seth Flaxman as Associate Professor of Computer Science and Tutorial Fellow, Jesus College, with email seth.flaxman@cs.ox.ac.uk.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests: scalable methods and flexible models for spatiotemporal statistics and Bayesian machine learning, applied to public policy and social science, including computational statistical disease modelling and deep learning from satellite and street-level imagery. Official theme: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Ana Namburete
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Ana Namburete as Associate Professor of Computer Science and Tutorial Fellow, Pembroke College, with email ana.namburete@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official biography also uses the title Associate Professor of Health Data Science and Artificial Intelligence and states she leads a research group on machine learning for fetal and neonatal neuroimaging. Official See Also lists Oxford Machine Learning in NeuroImaging (OMNI) Lab.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests: deep learning and computer vision for medical image analysis, applied to fetal and neonatal neuroimaging, including 3D brain reconstruction from freehand 2D ultrasound, segmentation, domain adaptation, and neurodevelopmental biomarker discovery. Official themes: Computational Biology and Health Informatics; Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Reuben Binns
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Reuben Binns as Director for Academic Environment and Associate Professor of Computer Science with email reuben.binns@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official biography states he works between computer science, law, and philosophy, focusing on data protection, machine learning, and the regulation of and by technology.
professors.research_summary: Official biography: data protection, machine learning, and regulation of and by technology. Official themes: Human Centred Computing; Security.

professors.name: Marta Kwiatkowska
professors.title: Professor of Computing Systems
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Marta Zofia Kwiatkowska as Professor of Computing Systems with email Marta.Kwiatkowska@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official doctoral study section states she welcomes applications for doctoral study and postdoctoral visitors in areas relevant to her research interests.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests: modelling and analysis methods for complex systems, including simulation and formal verification, with emphasis on quantitative verification of probabilistic systems, spanning theory, algorithms, software implementation, and applications.

professors.name: Christian Rupprecht
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science faculty list and profile list Christian Rupprecht as Associate Professor of Computer Science. The fetched official profile did not publish an email address or a detailed research statement beyond the departmental theme.
professors.research_summary: Official departmental theme listed on the profile: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. A more specific official research statement was not present on the fetched profile page.

professors.name: Sara Bernardini
professors.title: Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Sara Bernardini as Professor of Computer Science and Tutorial Fellow, Mansfield College, with email sara.bernardini@cs.ox.ac.uk.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests: Artificial Intelligence, specifically decision-making for intelligent autonomous systems (ground robots, drones, and underwater vehicles), and automated planning. Official themes include Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Niki Trigoni
professors.title: Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Niki Trigoni as Professor of Computer Science with email niki.trigoni@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official biography states she is Director of the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training on Autonomous Intelligent Machines and Systems and leads the Cyber Physical Systems Group. Official Interests ask prospective DPhil applicants to contact her and state that the group currently has a number of funded open positions.
professors.research_summary: Official Interests: intelligent and autonomous sensor systems with applications in positioning, healthcare, environmental monitoring and smart cities, including inference and learning from sensor data and human-robot interaction. Official themes include Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Andrew Markham
professors.title: Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Andrew Markham as Professor of Computer Science with email andrew.markham@cs.ox.ac.uk. Official text states he works within the Cyber Physical Systems theme; he is not assigned to the CPS lab record because the official page does not state that he leads that group.
professors.research_summary: Official About section: sensors, signal processing/machine learning, and systems (Physical AI), including machines from embedded systems to robots and autonomous vehicles. Official themes include Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

professors.name: Giuseppe De Giacomo
professors.title: Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official Oxford Computer Science profile lists Giuseppe De Giacomo as Professor of Computer Science with email giuseppe.degiacomo@cs.ox.ac.uk.
professors.research_summary: Official biography: Knowledge Representation, Reasoning about Actions, Generalized Planning, Autonomous Agents, Reactive Synthesis and Verification, among other AI and CS areas. Official themes include Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Official course listing includes Foundations of Self-Programming Agents.
